name: Heart of Winter
source:
An old story inspires a young boy to seek the Maiden of Winter that brings the snow and ice each year to his village. His mother is ill, and he believes the Maiden may be able to help...

Join a young boy on his adventure through the snowy forest to find an entity that can stop the wind and snow of winter. What will she offer him in exchange for his mother's life?

[From [url=https://nyanbacon.itch.io/heart-of-winter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个古老的故事激励一个小男孩去寻找每年为他的村庄带来冰雪的冬姑娘。他的母亲病了，他相信少女也许能够帮助……

和一个小男孩一起踏上冒险之旅，穿过白雪皑皑的森林，寻找一个可以阻止冬天风雪的实体。她会用什么来换取他母亲的生命？

[来自[url=https://nyanbacon.itch.io/heart-of-winter]itch.io[/url]]
